newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see more scattered rapemeal trades.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see more scattered rapemeal trades.

text.p: European meals and feeds closed the week with another handful of trades in rapemeal but most other products were neglected as players still had very little faith in market direction.

Buisness was reported in rapemeal positions through until next spring, with Cargill rumoure to be a major purchaser. Traders said rapemeal was fairly cheap compared to soymeal and the trade house had probably filled some export commitments.
But elsewhere, business was quiet, with traders watching for weather developments in the U.S., where signs of rainfall could cause a market sell-off.--Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
